links.targetTitle: When AI makes execution cheap, verification becomes the scarce resource that reprices trust
KYA (Know Your Agent) gives AI agents portable cryptographic identity binding principal, permissions, and reputation
x402 enables permissionless, accountless machine-to-machine micropayments for usage-based monetization

title: Agent-built OSS becomes fundable when x402 usage revenue closes the POWT deferred-compensation loop
content:
## The claim

Open-source funding chronically fails because consumption is unmetered (the free-rider problem). AI agents invert this: every agent use of an OSS tool is an API call, and x402 makes every API call payable — permissionless, accountless, sub-cent. Metered usage revenue gives Proof of Work Tokens a concrete redemption path, closing the loop that killed most token-incentive schemes: **x402 pays for usage today; POWTs pay for contribution whose value arrives later.**

## The loop

1. **OCF** funds bounties for OSS work (investor inflow)
2. Agents with **KYA-style identity** perform work under **bounded delegation** from a legal principal
3. Work is verified against the **event-sourced, signed audit trail** — issuance gates on *verified downstream value* (usage, adoption), never raw activity, to prevent slop-farming
4. **POWTs** are issued on verified merit (deferred upside in the project)
5. Project endpoints monetize per call via an **x402 facilitator**; the code itself stays open — what earns is the hosted, guaranteed, maintained endpoint
6. Revenue flows through the **RGH**, giving POWTs something to redeem against

## Why the fit is unusual

- The 10-cent interchange floor that made pay-the-maintainer-per-use impossible is gone (stablecoin rails settle $0.000001 transfers 24/7)
- Verification is the scarce resource in agent economies — and verifiable contribution records are precisely what an event-sourced reactor produces
- The SNO five-entity structure (DAO, OH, OCF, RGH, IP-holding) supplies the legal wrapper the agentic-payments ecosystem lacks (cf. Amazon v. Perplexity authorization gap)
- The payment rail is a commodity; the defensible layer is the **trust stack**: verifiable contribution + deferred incentives + legal home

## Honest caveats

- x402 volume ($24.24M/30 days, Apr 2026) is real and compounding ~15x/6mo but tiny in absolute terms; none of it is OSS-funding-shaped yet
- Gartner forecasts >40% of agentic AI projects cancelled by 2027 (open tension faa49708 vs the McKinsey $3-5T case) — build for the post-shakeout survivors
- Consumer agent PMF does not exist; the viable wedge is **B2B: agents maintaining developer infrastructure for businesses**
- Plannable market is the agent-consumed developer-infrastructure niche (tens of millions ARR by 2028 in the bear case), not the top-down trillions

Synthesized 2026-08-30 from the x402 docs, a16z crypto and LI.FI extractions in this vault, joined to the pre-existing POWT, OCF, RGH and SNO concept cluster.
